result.title: AdaTrendLike: Adaptive Hierarchical Detrending and Trend Likelihood Scoring for Time Series Anomaly Detection
result.summary: The rapid proliferation of Industrial Internet of Things devices has led to increasingly large-scale and non-stationary time-series data, posing significant challenges for time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). Existing approaches often focus on reconstructing or forecasting observations while overlooking the role of trend dynamics, which constitute a major source of non-stationarity and contain valuable information for anomaly identification. To address this limitation, we propose AdaTrendLike, a TSAD framework that directly estimates trend likelihoods for anomaly detection. Specifically, we introduce Standardization Embedding to capture local statistical characteristics as latent representations and AdaDetrending to adaptively decompose input series into trend and detrended components. The detrended component is processed through a Fast Fourier Transform and a complex-valued convolutional neural network to learn normal periodic patterns, while TrendEst models the distribution of the trend component. Based on the estimated distribution, TrendLike computes anomaly scores by measuring the likelihood of observed trends, enabling effective detection of deviations from normal behavior. In addition to improving detection performance, the proposed framework provides feature-level interpretability by identifying anomalies through deviations in the estimated trend distribution. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaTrendLike consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TSAD methods, validating its effectiveness and robustness across diverse application scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AdaTrendLike，一个面向时间序列异常检测的框架：用标准化嵌入得到局部统计的 latent 表示，自适应分解趋势与去趋势成分，再分别用 FFT 与复数卷积学习周期模式、用 TrendEst 建模趋势分布，以趋势似然打分检测异常。
AI.relevance_reason: 属工业 IoT 时间序列异常检测的分解与似然打分工作，虽出现「latent representation」，但指局部统计嵌入，与视觉细节保留、多模态推理状态生成或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策均无具体可借鉴联系。
